title: Guardian Signal — Mission One
description: Standalone Mission One rebuilt for Story Platform 0.11.7 from generic graph, environment, presentation and navigation primitives.

on_enter.text: Mission One is armed. Travel to Sol when ready.
Travel to Sol.
Incoming transmission — press Answer (CTRL+C).
Dock at Abraham Lincoln Station.
Go to Pioneer Supplies and stock up on energy cells and health packs. Then go to the bar and wait for your meeting.
Once you've recieved the earpiece, Press Accept (CTRL+A).
Confirm clearance?
Final opportunity to accept clearance.
Mission aborted.
press Accept (CTRL+A) if you understand.
Scanner installation and field orders received.

payload.text:
CLASSIFIED FIELD ORDERS

READ CAREFULLY! READ CAREFULLY! READ CAREFULLY! READ CAREFULLY! 

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Two unclassified energetic disturbances have been located within the SOLAR system. 

Detailed scanner readings are required to triangulate the source. 

Due to temporal distortions, digital location tagging is impossible. 

Locate and travel to the exact coordinates provided below: 


1 // IAPETUS // MOUNTAIN AREA
Latitude: 4.214506
Longitude: 97.075668


2 // ENCELADUS // ICE-LAKE AREA WITH GEYSERS
Latitude: -28.398161
Longitude: -132.245178


A temporal scanner has been installed on your ship. Activate it by pressing Control + S Once you are withing 1000km of an energetic disturbance.
The scanner will start to ping. The closer you get to the location, the faster the pings will become. 

You must get within 250 METERS of the disturbance and close to the surface to start the detailed scan process. This will start automatically as soon as you come within range.

Remain withing 250 METERS of the disturbance until the scan is complete. 

Do not transmit any telemetry data through normal channels! Once you've completed both scans, you will be contacted with
further instructions! 

Be sure to bring a ship with an SRV + ship launched fighter capacity and plenty of point defence turrets. And bring a shotgun! (They always come in handy eventually!)

Good Luck commander!

------------------------------------------------------------------------

on_enter.text: Complete the Iapetus and Enceladus anomaly scans in either order. Toggle scanner with CTRL+S.
Travel to Iapetus - There is 1 scan area remaining at: 4.214506, 97.075668.
Iapetus scan complete. Hold position for the analysis result.
Temporal distortion detected. Leave the 500-metre danger area.
Iapetus survey safely stored.
Travel to Enceladus. There is 1 scan area remaining at: -28.398161, -132.245178.
Enceladus scan complete. Hold position for the analysis result.
Temporal distortion detected. Leave the 500-metre danger area.
Enceladus survey safely stored.
Both anomaly surveys are safely stored.
All scans complete.

payload.text:
UNDERCOVER HANDOFF
Sol / Europa
Select: Unregistered Comms Beacon
Drop at the selected destination and hold position.

on_enter.text: Travel to Europa and drop-in on and select the Unregistered Comms Beacon there.
Unregistered Comms Beacon selected. Await message.
Receiving the undercover data handoff.

payload.text:
GUARDIAN BEACON
System: Synuefe IT-F d12-5
Select: Guardian Beacon

on_enter.text: Travel to: Synuefe IT-F d12-5 and investigate. It is the likely source of the signals you've discovered in the Sol system.
Incoming transmission — press Answer (CTRL+C).
Select the Guardian Beacon.
Guardian Beacon selected. Drop into its local instance.
Launch yourself into a ship-launched fighter. Tell your main ship to remain in place.
Fly the fighter to each of the Beacons 3 charge up points and charge them up fully with your lasers before the timer runs out.
Keep going through the pylon sequence.
Return to the main ship. park your fighter for a moment
Switch back to the fighter and knock the Ancient Key free.
Ancient Key acquired.

payload.text:
We think we may have finally found the true source of the mysterious temporal energy spikes. 

System: Synuefe EN-H d11-28

Jump there and Investigate.

on_enter.text: Travel to the Guardian Structure system.
Select the Guardian Structure.
Approach and land as close as you can to the Guardian Structure.
Prepare suit and weapons.
Locate the main altar of the temple and activate it's two energy pillars.
Great Job! Now follow the path back down the hill, and follow it straight through to the opposite side where you should find 2 more pillars to activate.
Run back to the central square. There should be a gateway on the right side that leads to a huge hill complex. On top of it you should find another pillar!
Run back to the central square again and keep running straight to the oppossite side. There will be a long path into a gate and up another hill. There you should find the final pilar.
Return to the ship and then deploy in your SRV.
Make sure to transfer the Ancient Key from your ship cargo hold, into your SRV before you drive off! Defeat the guardian sentinals and make your way back to the central altar of the site.
Park you SRV exactly on the X in front of the main altar. Jettison the Ancient key, to reset the system. Then scan the guardian data core.
Return to the main ship.
Return to the main ship.
Final transmission — press Answer (CTRL+C).
Final debrief received.
Take off like a boss!
Mission One complete.
Mission One complete.
